# Briefing: Meeting with Hugging Face
**Date:** November 20, 2026 | **Time:** 10:00 AM (+05:30)

## Recent developments
* **Executive Leadership & Vision:** At the Miami AI Summit on October 23, 2026, Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue predicted that every company will become an AI builder. He urged enterprise leaders to avoid relying solely on closed-source APIs (such as those from OpenAI and Anthropic), labeling it a risky path that concentrates excessive power in few hands [3].
* **Security & Open-Source Risks:** Chief Policy Officer Irene Solaiman warned on TechCrunch’s *Equity* podcast in November 2026 that a recent string of cyberattacks could pressure open-source AI toward tighter access controls if platforms continue to be targeted [1]. Delangue also revealed that during an autonomous AI agent cyberattack earlier in the year, open models (specifically a Chinese-developed GLM 5.3 model running on Nvidia hardware) were used by Hugging Face to neutralize the threat when proprietary API guardrails failed [3].
* **Regulatory & Acquisition Scrutiny:** Following Nvidia's major agreement to join forces with Hugging Face, the U.S. Department of Justice initiated inquiries regarding how the deal would impact AI market competition [2]. 

## Talking points
* **The Future of Open Source:** Discuss Delangue’s stance on enterprise independence from closed-source ecosystems and how Hugging Face plans to maintain open access amid rising regulatory and security pressures [1, 3].
* **Security Resilience:** Address Solaiman’s warnings regarding cyber threats and discuss how platforms can balance rigorous security governance without compromising the core ethos of open-source collaboration [1].
* **Ecosystem Integration & Corporate Strategy:** Touch upon enterprise adoption trends following the Miami AI Summit and how organizations can best integrate open-source models into their standard infrastructure [3].

## Open questions
* How are regulatory inquiries from the U.S. Department of Justice impacting Hugging Face's short-term roadmap and integration timelines?
* What specific structural guardrails is Hugging Face developing to prevent malicious actors from weaponizing open-source repositories for cyberattacks while keeping safe models widely accessible?
* How does Hugging Face plan to address executive concerns that rising security breaches could force the platform to transition toward tighter access tiers [1]?

## Sources
* [1] TechCrunch - Hugging Face Warns: Open Source Could Close Down Due to Cyberattacks (https://shattered.io/hugging-face-solaiman-open-source-ai-cyberattacks-two-attacks-2026)
* [2] TechCrunch - Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit (https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
* [3] Refresh Miami - At Miami AI Summit, Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue predicts every company will become an AI builder (https://refreshmiami.com/news/at-miami-ai-summit-hugging-face-ceo-clem-delangue-predicts-every-company-will-necome-an-ai-builder)
